description: Road furniture between places (16k type 10): the verge rocks, rock piles, wet bank rocks, trail cairns, burial cairns and the unlit pull-off fire ring that vanilla Skyrim sets beside its roads (world/sources/placement/vanilla-roadside-dressing.json: rocks 67/km at a 4.9 m median off the edge, cairns 1.2/km, campfires 0.28/km). The same vanilla meshes ship in flora-province-v1 as one-level scatter, which a place cannot stand (compile_settlement.lod_tiers_can_meet); this kit carries them with the full LOD chain so a route place seats and measures them like any piece. Every texture comes from the vanilla pool, the same files the province scatter's rocks wear, so a verge rock reads the same as the rocks the vegetation compile scatters around it. Signposts, walls and cart parts are not repeated here: they are on works-v1, settlement-imperial-v1 and hlaalu-domestic. Read by docs/research/placement-settlements/road-dressing.md.
